title: Finite local systems in cohomology of a restricted constant tensor
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] in the independent coefficient universe. Let $K$ belong to the ordinary derived category of modules over the constant $A$-ring on the coefficient-sized pro-etale site of $X$ [lem-sfb-adic-finite-reduction-data]. Assume that there is an integer $b$ such that $H^j(K)=0$ for $j>b$. Assume that for every $j$ for which $H^j(K)$ is nonzero, its fixed-scalar inverse image along $f$ is locally constant of finite type [def-pe-etale-constructible-module, def-sfb-affine-locally-constructible-proetale-modules]: over every site object $V$ there is a covering sieve $T$, and for every arrow $W\to V$ of $T$ there is a finitely generated $A$-module $N$ whose constant sheaf on the slice at $W$ is isomorphic to the restriction of that inverse image to the slice. Let $M$ be a finitely generated $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Realize it by the exact constant module functor [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor] in degree zero and use the recorded K-flat tensor [lem-weil-pbc-kflat-fixed-tensor-triangulated]. Then, for every integer $q$, the fixed-scalar inverse image $f^*H^q(K\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}\underline M[0])$ is locally constant of finite type on the entire coefficient-sized pro-etale site of $Y$, in precisely the same covering-sieve and constant slice-module sense. No constructibility predicate, stratification, scheme Noetherianity or lower cohomology bound is assumed.

proof.text: Use the bounded flat model lemma to obtain a termwise bounded-above K-flat intrinsic complex P on Y and derived isomorphisms representing the exact restricted K and its constant tensor. Apply homology to these derived isomorphisms. The exact derived-functor homology comparison identifies H(P), after scalar restriction, with fixed-scalar pullback of H(K).

The small_models predicate comparison identifies the covering-sieve constant-module condition with intrinsic locally constant finite type. For a nonzero H^j(K), transport hloc along the previous homology isomorphism on every slice. For a zero H^j(K), exact pullback sends it to zero; reflect zero through the faithful scalar equivalence and apply zero_lisse. Thus every H^j(P) has intrinsic finite local models.

Rewrite the Grothendieck topology as the one generated by its associated precoverage. Apply the already proved generic finite_tensor_lisse to P and the finite A-module M; it gives intrinsic locally constant finite type cohomology of termwise constant(M) tensorLeft P. Apply small_models again and transport its slice-wise constant-module isomorphisms along the tensor homology isomorphism to get the original conclusion. No finite coefficient-set, stalk, field, or lower-bound hypotheses are used.

theorem coefficientConstantTensor_restricted_finite
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (K : adicFiniteAmbient.{u, v} X A)
    (hK : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ j : ℤ, b < j →
      CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero ((coefficientModelCohomology _ j).obj K))
    (hloc : ∀ j : ℤ,
      ¬ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero ((coefficientModelCohomology _ j).obj K) →
      IsCoefficientModelLocallyConstantFinite
        (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} Y) A
        ((coefficientProEtaleFixedModulePullback.{u, v} f A).obj
          ((coefficientModelFixedScalars _ A).obj
            ((coefficientModelCohomology _ j).obj K))))
    (M : ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A) (hM : Module.Finite A M) (q : ℤ) :
    let R := constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (Mod R)
    IsCoefficientModelLocallyConstantFinite
      (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} Y) A
      ((coefficientProEtaleFixedModulePullback.{u, v} f A).obj
        ((coefficientModelFixedScalars _ A).obj
          ((coefficientModelCohomology _ q).obj
            (((SheafOfModules.KFlatFixedTensor.derivedTensor R).obj K).obj
              ((Q R).obj ((HomologicalComplex.single (Mod R) (.up ℤ) 0).obj
                ((commutativeSiteConstantModuleFunctor
                  (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A).obj M)))))))
